hero.title: Partner With BLAK
hero.description: BLAK helps hotels, resorts, property managers, concierge companies, private aviation and other hospitality partners offer premium ground transportation under one consistent standard.

form.title: Join the BLAK Partner Network
form.description: Give your guests access to a consistent, first-class ground transportation experience through the BLAK network.
form.note: There is no cost to apply or join the initial BLAK Partner Network. Applications are subject to verification and approval.

elevateGuestExperience.title: Elevate the Guest Experience

consistentStandards.description: Give your guests a dependable experience built around service, professionalism, and presentation.

simplifyTransportation.title: Simplify Transportation
